sar.narrative: Customer C07297, holder of card C07297-K1, is the subject of this report. Between 2016-11-21 20:00 and 2016-11-21 20:30, 4 transaction(s) totalling $1,906.07 were made on the card online from device profile 'Trident/7.0 | Windows 7 | ie 11.0 for desktop | 1920x1080': $478.95 (3476602, 2016-11-21 20:00), $456.96 (3476633, 2016-11-21 20:10), $488.04 (3476665, 2016-11-21 20:24), $482.12 (3476682, 2016-11-21 20:30). Every amount sat just below $500 and the purchases were placed minutes apart, a pattern consistent with deliberately staying under an authorisation threshold. The cardholder reported the transaction as unauthorised. The activity is suspicious because: 4 online purchases within 30 minutes, each between $400 and $500 ($478.95, $456.96, $488.04, $482.12; total $1,906.07). It closely resembles earlier confirmed fraud cases CC-3748, CC-3841, CC-3907. The bank has recommended blocking and reissuing the card, placing linked cards under monitoring where applicable, and retaining the transaction, device and investigation records as supporting documentation.

stop_reason: Fraud probability 0.97 is at or above 0.85 with 3 independent pieces of evidence, so the decision is defensible without asking the customer (policy 6).
